---
title: "PD strict spectrum"
description: "Inspect strict Proteome Discoverer spectrum evidence for PTM-focused validation."
---

## Purpose

**PD Strict Spectrum** provides a dedicated route for Proteome Discoverer evidence that needs stricter spectrum-level inspection than a protein-level abundance table can provide.

## Workflow principles

1. Use the original Proteome Discoverer export expected by the module.
2. Confirm peptide sequence, modification/site annotation, spectrum identifiers and score/evidence fields before applying filters.
3. Retain the unfiltered source file and export the exact filtered subset used for interpretation.
4. For candidate PTM sites used in a manuscript, manually inspect the relevant fragmentation/localization evidence when possible.

::: {.callout-note}
Spectrum-level validation supports identification confidence; it does not replace quantitative replication or statistical testing across biological samples.
:::
